description: This file provides utility functions and structures for making HTTP requests, handling retries, uploading files and file chunks, and building multipart requests, primarily used within the 'libhoclient' package in a Go-based project.

classes.name: HTTPHelper
classes.description: Provides methods to create HTTP requests, dump request/response, and hold HTTP client configurations.

classes.name: HTTPRequestBuilder
classes.description: A builder pattern for creating, customizing, and executing HTTP requests with optional retries.

classes.name: ApiCallError
classes.description: Custom error type for API call failures (not explicitly shown, assumed to exist based on usage).

classes.name: FileInfo
classes.description: Holds filename and total number of chunks for the file to be uploaded.

classes.name: ExpBackOffOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for exponential backoff retries.

classes.name: UploadOptions
classes.description: Configuration for file upload behavior including backoff options, chunk size, and worker count.

classes.name: FilesUploader
classes.description: Manages uploading multiple files in chunks using concurrent workers with retry logic.

classes.name: uploadChunkJob
classes.description: Represents a specific chunk of a file to be uploaded, including chunk number and total chunks.

classes.name: uploadChunkWorker
classes.description: Worker responsible for uploading file chunks with retry logic and tracing.

methods.name: NewGetRequest
methods.description: Creates a new GET HTTP request for the specified path.

methods.name: NewDeleteRequest
methods.description: Creates a new DELETE HTTP request for the specified path.

methods.name: NewPostRequest
methods.description: Creates a new POST HTTP request with a JSON body.

methods.name: NewUploadFileRequest
methods.description: Creates a new PUT request with a file upload payload.

methods.name: dumpRequest
methods.description: Dumps the HTTP request details to the Dumpster writer if configured.

methods.name: dumpResponse
methods.description: Dumps the HTTP response details to the Dumpster writer if configured.

methods.name: AddHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the HTTP request.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets a header, replacing any existing value.

methods.name: SetBasicAuth
methods.description: Sets basic authentication headers on the request.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request with default retry options.

methods.name: JSONResDo
methods.description: Executes the request expecting a JSON response to be decoded into the provided variable.

methods.name: JSONResDoWithRetries
methods.description: Executes the request with retries, decoding JSON response.

methods.name: setAuthz
methods.description: Sets authorization headers based on available tokens or credentials.

methods.name: doWithRetries
methods.description: Performs the request with retry logic based on specified options.

methods.name: isIn
methods.description: Checks if a status code is within the list of retriable status codes.

methods.name: getFilesInfos
methods.description: Retrieves file info including filename and total chunks based on chunk size.

methods.name: sendJobs
methods.description: Dispatches file chunk upload jobs to worker goroutines.

methods.name: startWorkers
methods.description: Starts worker goroutines to process upload jobs and collects their errors.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the upload of a file chunk and returns a channel with upload results.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading a single file chunk with retry logic.

methods.name: writeMultipartRequest
methods.description: Produces a multipart form request body for a file chunk.

methods.name: addFormField
methods.description: Adds a form field to a multipart writer.
